summary.name: MEGA
summary.one_liner: MEGA is an end-to-end encrypted cloud storage service that also bundles a VPN, password manager, S3-compatible object storage, and chat/meetings.
use_cases: sharing files privately with people without accounts
syncing computer folders to the cloud
migrating files from Google Drive or Dropbox
summary.what_it_does: MEGA offers cloud storage where files are encrypted with zero-knowledge encryption, so only the owner and authorised users hold the keys. Users can share files and folders with read-only or full access, optionally protected by a password or expiring links, including with people who lack MEGA accounts. Desktop, mobile and web apps can sync or back up folders, with changes replicated in real time. The page also lists add-on services: a VPN with built-in ad blocking, MEGA Pass for password management, MEGA S4 S3-compatible object storage, and chat and meetings. A migration tool is advertised for transferring files directly from Google Drive, Dropbox, and Box.
notable: Zero-knowledge encryption: MEGA cannot read stored data
Free plan with 20 GB storage; paid plans up to 20TB
Direct migration from Google Drive, Dropbox and Box
caveats: Paid plans are needed for storage beyond the free 20 GB
The Awesome-mac listing cites 50GB free, which conflicts with the page's 20 GB figure
